jobs.description:
A leading international food manufacturer which operates in a fast-moving consumer goods environment and manages a portfolio of well-known consumer brands with strong market recognition.The organization places a strong emphasis on sustainability, quality, and consumer-centric strategies.In Belgium, it collaborates closely with major retailers, distributors, and foodservice partners to strengthen its market presence.

Jobomschrijving

The Key Account Manager FMCG will be in charge of the following responsibilities :

• Manage and develop relationships with major retail and strategic accounts.
• Lead the negotiation of annual agreements, pricing, promotional plans, and commercial terms.
• Build and implement joint business plans to achieve revenue, profitability, and market share objectives.
• Identify growth opportunities and develop account-specific strategies to maximize performance.
• Monitor sales performance, customer profitability, and category trends through data-driven analysis.
• Forecast sales accurately and manage account budgets effectively.
• Conduct regular business reviews with customers and present recommendations to drive growth.
• Track competitor activity, market developments, and consumer trends to inform commercial decisions.

• At least 3 years of experience in Key Account Management, Category management, Trade Marketing or Customer Development within FMCG sector.
• Excellent negotiation, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
• Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate data into actionable business recommendations.
• Highly results-oriented with a proactive and entrepreneurial approach.
• Fluent in French or Dutch with a good comprehension of the other national language. English mandatory.

jobs.occupation: g2 Recruitment Solutions - Life Sciences Transformation - Business Analyst
jobs.description:
• Location: Antwerp, Belgium (Hybrid)

• Contract: 12-Month Initial Contract (Extension Likely)

• Language: English

• Start Date: December

• Industry: Life Sciences / Healthcare

• Engagement: Freelance

Our client, a leading European Life Sciences & Healthcare organisation, is embarking on a large-scale IT, Cloud & Business Transformation Programme aimed at modernising core business applications, streamlining operational processes, and accelerating their cloud journey.

As the programme enters a critical delivery phase, they are looking for a highly hands-on Senior Business Analyst who can bridge the gap between business stakeholders and technology teams, driving requirements definition, process optimisation, and transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams.

This is not a documentation-only role. We are looking for someone who enjoys being Embedded within the business, challenging existing ways of working, facilitating workshops, and actively shaping future-state solutions.
Responsibilities

• Engage with business and technical stakeholders to understand current-state processes and system landscapes.

• Lead requirements gathering workshops across multiple departments.

• Analyse and document complex business processes, identifying inefficiencies and improvement opportunities.

• Develop current-state and future-state process MAPS.

• Define and document business, functional and non-functional requirements.

• Translate business requirements into actionable functional specifications.

• Work closely with solution architects, developers, project managers and integration teams throughout project delivery.

• Support cloud migration and application transformation initiatives.

• Conduct gap analyses between legacy systems and future-state solutions.

• Facilitate stakeholder alignment and decision-making workshops.

• Support testing activities including UAT planning, execution and defect management.

• Track requirements through implementation to ensure business objectives are achieved.

• Drive continuous improvement initiatives across business and technology functions.

• 7+ years' experience as a Business Analyst within complex enterprise environments.

• Proven experience working on large-scale IT transformation programmes.

• Strong background in business process analysis and optimisation.

• Experience gathering and managing requirements across multiple stakeholder groups.

• Demonstrated experience working on cloud transformation, digital transformation, ERP, CRM or systems integration projects.

• Ability to challenge stakeholders constructively and influence decisions.

• Strong workshop facilitation skills.

• Experience operating in Agile, Waterfall or hybrid delivery environments.

• Excellent communication skills with both business and technical audiences.

Preferred experience:

• Experience within Life Sciences, Pharmaceuticals, Biotechnology, Healthcare or Medical Devices industries.

• Exposure to cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS or GCP.

• Experience supporting application migration or modernisation programmes.

• Understanding of regulated environments and compliance requirements.

• Knowledge of data migration, integration projects or enterprise application landscapes.

Key skills:

• Business Analysis

• Requirements Engineering

• Process Mapping

• BPMN

• Stakeholder Management

• Workshop Facilitation

• Gap Analysis

• Systems Integration

• Cloud Transformation

• Agile Methodologies

• User Stories

• Functional Specifications

• UAT Management

• Change Management

Our client is a well-established international financial services organization with a strong local presence in Belgium. To support its continued growth and digital transformation, they are looking for an IT Coordinator who will act as the key liaison between the local business, international IT teams, and external technology partners.This is a highly visible role offering a balanced mix of operational service management, stakeholder engagement, governance, and project delivery. Rather than being a hands-on technical expert, you will ensure that IT services are delivered efficiently, compliantly, and in line with both local business needs and international standards.

Jobomschrijving

Application & Service Management

• Act as the primary point of contact for business applications.
• Coordinate IT service delivery throughout the entire lifecycle, including incidents, changes, releases, and performance management.
• Oversee and monitor Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
• Manage external suppliers, including service levels, contracts, costs, quality, and performance.
• Facilitate collaboration between business stakeholders, international IT teams, and service providers to deliver sustainable and effective solutions.
• Ensure accurate documentation and compliance with group IT governance and control frameworks.
IT Infrastructure, Network & Digital Workplace

• Coordinate infrastructure and digital workplace services in partnership with international IT teams and external vendors.
• Monitor the quality and availability of workplace technologies, including hardware, networking, and telephony services.
• Oversee incident management processes and ensure timely escalation to the appropriate teams.
• Support the alignment of global IT standards and processes with local operational requirements.
• Represent the local organization within international IT communities and initiatives.
Project Management & Product Ownership

• Coordinate and follow up on IT projects involving internal stakeholders and external partners.
• Translate business requirements into practical IT solutions, acting as the bridge between local business needs and the central IT roadmap.
• Ensure successful implementation and delivery of technology solutions within agreed timelines and scope.
• Manage project scope, planning, risks, and stakeholder expectations.
• Build and maintain strong relationships with international colleagues and key stakeholders.
• Identify opportunities for process optimization, innovation, and service improvement.
IT Governance, Compliance & Administration

• Monitor IT-related expenditures, invoices, and budgets.
• Contribute to IT risk and control frameworks, including regulatory requirements such as DORA, GDPR, and MiFID II.
• Ensure IT services comply with internal policies and external regulatory obligations.
• Monitor and continuously improve IT processes within the local business environment.
• Serve as a point of contact for audits and compliance-related activities.
• Support Business Continuity initiatives through planning, testing, and safeguarding critical business processes.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 5 years of experience in an IT-related role.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft technologies, including SharePoint, Teams, Outlook, Word, and Excel.
• Understanding of IT infrastructure, networking, and cloud environments is considered an asset.
• Strong service-oriented mindset with the ability to coordinate and drive initiatives forward.
• Excellent stakeholder management and relationship-building skills.
• Able to connect people, facilitate collaboration, and navigate across different levels of an organization.
• Strong organizational and administrative skills with great attention to detail.
• Quality-driven with a focus on service continuity and operational excellence.
• Strong communication and teamwork skills.
• Fluent in Dutch and English; knowledge of French is a strong advantage.

BPYP Consultancy supports companies with recruitment and selection. For our client, a growing machine builder in the South-East Flanders region, we are looking for a Business Development Engineer.
 

Your role
 

You develop and execute sales strategies, build relationships with key customers and partners, and provide technical support to drive sales growth and customer satisfaction in your assigned region.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• Develop and execute sales strategies to reach ambitious sales targets 

• Build and maintain relationships with key customers and partners 

• Provide technical support to customers and partners so the technology is implemented and used successfully 

• Work with cross-functional teams, including marketing, product development and operations 

• Carry out market research and competitive analysis to find opportunities for growth and differentiation 

• Prepare and deliver sales presentations, product demonstrations and technical papers 

• Manage and track sales activities, forecasts and pipelines 

• Report regularly to senior management with sales figures and insights  

Practical
 
 

• Full-time, permanent contract 

• Travel up to 25 to 30% of the time in your assigned region to meet customers and partners 
 

• A technical bachelor's or master's degree in mechanical or electrical engineering, or a related field 

• At least 5 years of experience in a technical sales role 

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, written and verbal 

• A proven track record in developing and executing sales strategies that drive revenue growth 

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills 

• Able to work independently and in a team, self-motivated and results-driven 

• Fluent English is required; other languages are a plus

BPYP Consultancy supports companies with recruitment and selection. For our client, a growing machine builder in the South-East Flanders region, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer.
 

Your role
 

You play a pivotal role in transforming innovative machine concepts into reliable, high-performance electrical systems. As the technical owner of the electrical design, you bridge project requirements and practical implementation, making sure every machine is engineered to the highest quality and safety standards.
 

Electrical design and project planning
 
 

• From the conceptual phase onwards, you take part in project design meetings with multidisciplinary engineering teams 

• You create realistic project schedules and contribute to the joint planning meetings 

• After the concept phase, you take ownership of the electrical descriptions and translate draft descriptions and specifications into clear, detailed guidelines for the electrical hardware design 

• You design and adjust the electrical drawings in Eplan P8 and the 3D electrical layouts in Eplan Pro Panel 

• You make sure all designs comply with the applicable standards and regulations (EN 60204, MD, EMC, LVD and others)  

Execution and collaboration
 
 

• Once the design is finished, you create and update ERP work orders for customer-specific projects and the masters for standard machines 

• You follow up closely with production during assembly 

• As a senior, you develop, maintain and improve electrical design guidelines and best practices 

• You support colleagues and review schematics with them for accuracy 

• You contribute to standardisation initiatives in the department and gradually take the lead in driving them forward  

Practical
 
 

• Full-time, permanent contract 
 

• A master's degree in industrial sciences (electromechanics or electrotechnics), or equivalent experience 

• At least 5 years of experience in electrical engineering, preferably in machine building 

• Solid knowledge of electrical standards; knowledge of UL standards is a plus 

• Good knowledge of Eplan P8; Eplan Pro Panel is a plus 

• An analytical mind and a problem solver 

• A good communicator and team player in an international environment 

• Good knowledge of English and Dutch

jobs.description:
Our client is a leading Belgian communications and marketing company, with offices in the heart of Brussels and close to the trainstation.

Jobomschrijving

Our client is a leading professional services organization operating a network of accounting and advisory offices across Belgium. Driven by strong growth ambitions and a continuous focus on innovation, the company has invested significantly in digital transformation, process excellence, and modern technologies to support both its employees and clients.As part of its long-term strategy, the company is building a future-oriented environment where technology and people work hand in hand. The Digital Team plays a key role in this journey by identifying opportunities to simplify processes, standardize ways of working, and unlock the potential of emerging technologies across the business.To support this journey, they are seeking a Digital & Process Expert (AI) to play a key role in shaping and delivering their digital transformation initiatives.

Jobomschrijving

As a Digital Expert, you will play a central role in shaping and accelerating the organization's digital and AI transformation agenda.Your responsibilities will include:

• Analyzing existing business processes across accounting offices and identifying opportunities for optimization, standardization, and automation.
• Defining future-state processes and selecting the most appropriate technologies to support them.
• Driving the adoption of digital tools such as accounting, reporting, workflow, and collaboration platforms.
• Identifying and implementing AI-powered solutions that enhance productivity, reduce manual work, and improve service quality.
• Monitoring emerging trends in Artificial Intelligence, machine learning, automation, and digital innovation, and translating these into concrete business opportunities.
• Designing and coordinating change management and implementation strategies for large-scale transformation projects.
• Acting as a trusted advisor to management and business stakeholders regarding digitalization initiatives and process improvements.
• Collaborating closely with key users and local offices to ensure successful adoption of new technologies.
• Supporting continuous improvement initiatives through feedback collection, process reviews, and performance monitoring.
• Building and facilitating internal communities to share best practices, success stories, and knowledge related to digital tools and AI applications.
• Serving as the link between operational teams, leadership, and technology partners to ensure digital initiatives deliver measurable business value.
This position combines business analysis, process improvement, technology consulting, AI enablement, and change management in a highly visible role.

The ideal candidate combines strong business acumen with a genuine passion for technology, digital innovation, and Artificial Intelligence.You are likely to bring:

• Several years of experience in a digital transformation, business analysis, process improvement, consulting, or change management role.
• A solid understanding of accounting workflows, financial processes, or professional services environments. Experience within accountancy is considered a strong asset.
• A strong interest in AI technologies and their practical application in business environments.
• Experience working with digital platforms, workflow tools, automation solutions, or business software ecosystems.
• Excellent analytical skills with the ability to identify inefficiencies and translate complex challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
• A collaborative mindset and the ability to engage users at all levels of the organization.
• A pragmatic and hands-on approach, balancing long-term strategic objectives with short-term business needs.
• The ability to explain complex technological concepts, including AI-related topics, in a simple and accessible manner.
• Curiosity, adaptability, and a continuous improvement mindset.
• Willingness to travel regularly to various offices and work closely with local teams.
• Professional proficiency in Dutch and English, with French considered a valuable asset.
Most importantly, you enjoy helping people embrace change and are motivated by the opportunity to make technology and AI create tangible business impact.

Do you value sustainability? Do you want to make a meaningful impact on your community?

Are you a handy jack-of-all-rounder with a passion for maintenance? Then I’m looking for you!

For a company in Aalter that specializes in structural steel, I’m looking for a motivated Maintenance Technician!

• You’ll perform preventive and corrective maintenance on pneumatic, mechanical, and hydraulic systems.
• You’ll thoroughly troubleshoot and resolve malfunctions in machines and systems.

Vol-au-vent, tomato soup with meatballs, or the perfectly cooked roast beef: dishes that make your mouth water. In this role, you help make sure others can enjoy them too. In our kitchen, we produce preparations that would make grandmothers jealous, but on an industrial scale and in large quantities.

We are looking for a Cook in the Aalter region! 
What are your responsibilities? 
• Hygiene is essential for any kitchen employee. That is why you ensure every day that your working methods and finished products comply with all applicable standards.
• You strictly follow all safety regulations. You do everything possible to guarantee both quality and safety. 
Who are you?
• You have experience as a cook in a large-scale catering kitchen or an industrial kitchen. Experience in a production environment is a plus.
• You are able and willing to work in a rotating two-shift system. 
• The early shift starts at 4:30 AM and ends at 12:30 PM.
• The late shift starts at 12:45 PM and ends at 8:00 PM. 
• Team player – You are friendly, enthusiastic, and enjoy working with others. Helping colleagues comes naturally to you.
• Hands-on – You are proactive, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and have strong practical insight.
• Flexible – You like working as part of a team but can also work independently. In addition, you enjoy the variety of working with different products and tasks.
• Communicative – You have good communication skills and a good command of Dutch and/or English.

Purpose and Mission
 

To ensure Bexco Synthetic Ropes by Bekaert are the solution of choice in offshore operations applications (Single Point Mooring & Lifting Solutions). Organize and manage all commercial activity related to offshore operations. Create opportunities and secure orders to ensure the business meets its commercial objectives in line with the profit plan and agreed objectives and strategies.
This opportunity is ideally suited for a 
junior professional with a strong commercial drive and the ambition to grow in an international environment. The position involves 
approximately 40% international travel to build and strengthen customer relationships and explore new business opportunities.
 

Key Activities and Responsibilities
 

1. Identify concrete market potential, emerging trends, and industry shifts, including targeted qualification of key (lead) accounts within defined Single Point Mooring (SPM) applications.
